FLIR T840-80 Offers
Work safely and effectively with this thermal imaging camera with its ergonomic tilting optical block and an array of lenses (sold separately) designed to meet your application needs. Unique features such as Route Creator, METERLiNK®, and wireless data streaming maximize your efficiency. In addition, intuitive, on-camera features such as 1-Touch Level/Span, inspection routing, voice, text and sketch annotation, and laser autofocus simplify and streamline workflows.
Improve workflow efficiencies
Collect and manage critical data quickly and easily.
Change from wide area scanning to telephoto instantly with the FlexView™ dual field-of-view lens
Develop inspection routes in Thermal Studio Pro with Route Creator and upload them to the camera for streamlined inspections of critical assets
Acquire temperature data and thermal and visual imagery in a logical sequence for faster preventative/predictive maintenance procedures
Upload directly and securely to Ignite cloud and automate data management and reporting through easy transfer of organized files to Thermal Studio Pro
Work safely and comfortably
Assess the state of equipment from a safe distance, at any angle, or in any lighting condition.
Use the camera in any environment, indoors or out, with a large, vibrant 4" (101.6 mm) color LCD display and an integrated eyepiece viewfinder for working in bright sunlight
Image targets overhead or down low without strain thanks to the 180° rotating optical block and ergonomic design
Accurately measure small targets over long distances or in large scenes by pairing the high-resolution IR sensor with the 6° telephoto lens (sold separately)
Make critical decisions quickly
Save time and share data faster to increase in-field efficiency.
Ensure precision measurement with laser-assisted autofocus, 1-Touch Level/Span, and exceptional temperature accuracy
Avoid diagnostic errors with industry-leading image clarity from Vision Processing™, combining MSX®, UltraMax®, and proprietary adaptive filtering algorithms
Optimize workflows with reporting features such as built-in voice annotation, customizable work folders, and Wi-Fi sync to mobile apps
Applications
Preventative/predictive maintenance
Electrical and mechanical equipment
Inspections
Cabinett and building inspections

Type: Li-ion battery, charged in camera or on separate charger
Operating time: Approximately 4 hours at 77°F (25°C) ambient temperature and typical use
